name: lw_50221
statement: (a b c : ℝ) (hx: a > 0 ∧ b > 0 ∧ c > 0) (hab : a + b > c) (hbc : b + c > a) (hca : a + c > b) : a^3 / b^2 + b^3 / c^2 + c^3 / a^2 ≥ a / c * (a + b - c) + c / b * (c + a - b) + b / a * (b + c - a)
closed: ∀ (a b c : ℝ) (hx: a > 0 ∧ b > 0 ∧ c > 0) (hab : a + b > c) (hbc : b + c > a) (hca : a + c > b), a^3 / b^2 + b^3 / c^2 + c^3 / a^2 ≥ a / c * (a + b - c) + c / b * (c + a - b) + b / a * (b + c - a)
informal: Let $a,b,c$ be the sides of a triangle. Prove that $\frac{a^{3}}{b^{2}}+\frac{b^{3}}{c^{2}}+\frac{c^{3}}{a^{2}}\geq \frac{a}{c}(a+b-c)+\frac{c}{b}(c+a-b)+\frac{b}{a}(b+c-a)$ .
